column3: NASB leaves “the angel of the LORD” lowercase; “a bush” renders “seneh,” a thornbush.
“from the power of” renders “from the hand of.”
“I AM WHO I AM” renders “ehyeh asher ehyeh,” which may also mean “I will be what I will be.”
“The LORD” renders the divine name YHWH, linked to “I AM” in verse 14.
“except under compulsion” renders “not even by a strong hand,” which the Greek reads “except by a strong hand.”
